entries.title: White Day: A Labyrinth Named School

emulation.notes: Use an owned original PC copy and compatibility fixes as needed.

primary.why: The 2001 White Day is the original Korean PC survival-horror game and is distinct from the later remake; no sourced official modern rerelease of the original build was identified.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned original Windows PC copy if you specifically want the 2001 game. For most new players, use the separately listed 2015 remake.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not conflate the 2001 original with the 2015 remake; they are separate entries in this archive.

entries.title: White Day: A Labyrinth Named School (2015 remake)

emulation.notes: Use the native Steam release for capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with PC capture/display flexibility.

primary.why: The Steam PC remake is the best fidelity/capture route for the modern remake, which adds improved graphics/audio, reworked mechanics, additional languages, and new story segments around Yoo Ji-min.
primary.how_to_play: Buy White Day: A Labyrinth Named School on Steam for the primary remake route. Use PS5, Xbox Series, Switch, PS4, or mobile only for platform preference.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a remake of the 2001 game, not a simple port; the original 2001 game is tracked separately.

entries.title: White Day 2: The Flower That Tells Lies

emulation.notes: Use the native Steam Complete Edition for capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with PC capture/display flexibility.

primary.why: The Steam Complete Edition is the best PC capture route and bundles the three episodes of the sequel with its released DLC content.
primary.how_to_play: Buy White Day 2: The Flower That Tells Lies - Complete Edition on Steam. Use PS5 or Xbox Series X|S only for platform preference.

entries.remaster_caveats: Direct sequel, not a remake of the first White Day.
